title: My experiences in Mallworld like dreams.
content: I've had a few mallworld like experiences in my dreams. I'll share the most vivid ones I can remember as sometimes I forget them shortly after waking. I'm not sure how often I've been in these spaces but as of the last year it's been about 5 or more. Usually the same places. Dream #1: My cousin's old house. Seemingly endless interior rooms and a wraparound porch. The details on this one are hazy but I remember being here in this space for years. Like a nostalgic kind of feeling. There's a garage off to the side that seemingly had another living space connected to it that had a basement that went down to a room with a bunch of old computer monitors. (This area seems the most common, the hallways at least) Usually at this point I realize I'm dreaming and am just exploring. I get maybe 5mins before my brain ejects me from my dream or my work alarm goes off. Anyway after waking up I realize that my dream wasn't my cousin's house??? The setting is there but it's an uncanny mess because there's no porch and the garage has no living space. I live in a very swampy area below sea level technically so basements are nearly non-existent. I think the porch is a reference to a tree house on the back of the property. Still uncanny though. Dream #2: I'm talking to a woman (Conversation forgotten) while wandering a hallway similar to the first dream in the garage area. Feels like home, like I've lived here with them. Can't remember much about this dream aside from a hallway that opens into a dining area with a fine china cabinet. Ahead and to the left are the bathrooms. A hall that has sinks and mirrors akin to a bathroom but no toilets sometimes. Dream #3: I sell fish for a living and we get catfish that comes in boxes. Anyway I need to use the bathroom and find myself in the same kitchenette bathroom area near the basement. I go to use the bathroom and find boxes of rotten catfish everywhere. I try to text my boss to tell there's a problem and it clicks... This isn't normal. I can't see my reflection in the mirror. Just a manakin like reflection. I'm dreaming I think. I try to relieve myself to no avail... (Mind you there's no toilets) I go to try to find the lady cause I can feel them there or know they are there and wake up. These dreams are what I can remember and they have been my experiences. If I have more I'll share them here with y'all.
